_note: size_m = [x width, y depth, z height] in metres, Blender axes (Godot: x, z, y). Fronts face Blender -Y (Godot +Z). Origin on the ground at the footprint centre unless origin says centre. collision null = walk-through / no blocking footprint.

props.name: tree_jungle_1
props.notes: Big jungle tree, wide canopy with big leaves and vines. Collision = trunk; the low roots spread to ~1.6 m. For the Gloom woods, tint it violet in the shader.

props.name: tree_jungle_2
props.notes: Big jungle tree with a forked trunk and two canopy tiers, arching roots. For the Gloom woods, tint it violet in the shader.

props.name: tree_round
props.notes: Smaller round-canopy tree (grown-camp style). For the Gloom woods, tint it violet in the shader.

props.name: bush_1
props.notes: Round leafy bush with two small flowers.

props.name: monstera
props.notes: Big tropical leaf clump (split leaves), walk-through decor.

props.name: rock_2
props.notes: Large rock with a mossy top.

props.name: stepping_stone
props.notes: Flat stepping stone for paths, walkable.

props.name: flower_small_white
props.notes: Three small white daisies, walk-through decor.

props.name: mushroom_cluster
props.notes: Red-capped mushrooms on a moss tuft, walk-through decor.

props.name: gloom_crystal
props.notes: Violet crystal cluster from the ground (Gloom woods). Crystal faces are bright so the game can make them glow.

props.name: log_fallen
props.notes: Mossy fallen log along X; cut end at -X, broken end at +X.
